F O R M I D A B L E E X C L U S I V I T Y
Luxury, scale and space meet phenomenal dynamic capabilities in
the Maserati Quattroporte – and it’s all perfectly expressed by its
stately yet dynamically intense exterior.
The front is dominated by the grille bearing the iconic Trident.
Inspired by the Alfieri concept, its deep-cut design creates a
predatory shark-nose effect. The imposing presence is brought into
even sharper focus by stylish new Adaptive full LED headlights.
Other striking details include triple air vents in the wings, the
Saetta logo in the C-pillars and frameless windows. To the rear,
quad chrome tailpipes signpost the continent-crossing power.

T H E G R A N L U S S O I N T E R I O R
B Y M A S E R A T I
The Quattroporte GranLusso is crafted for individuals who desire
higher levels of luxury. Which is why this model features a
remarkably exclusive interior, styled and crafted by Ermenegildo
Zegna, one of Italy’s most celebrated fashion designer brands.
The finest leathers are combined with Zegna’s mulberry silk inserts
on the seats, door panels, roof lining and ceiling light fixture. The
silk is embellished with a hand-stitched micro-chevron pattern,
while the seating features a central silk insert with a macro-chevron
weave. All this is available in three combinations of leather and silk
with contrast stitching.
Other GranLusso cabin refinements include a wood and leather
steering wheel, wood trim, power foot pedals, a power rear
sunblind, four-zone climate control and heated rear seats.
22 23

S H A R P E R S P O R T I N G F O C U S
Another option with the Maserati Quattroporte is the GranSport
trim, which focuses more squarely on dynamic style. This features
boldly sculpted angles for the central front and side intakes, and
a lower section equipped with aerodynamic splitters. The centre
spoiler and side inserts, meanwhile, are finished in Black Piano.
The grille is also optionally available in black, while the Trident
has inserts in the blue of the original from the 1920s. This same
blue features on the Saetta logo in the C-pillars and the wheel
hubs. The stretched side profile, with its GranSport badging, is yet
more impactful thanks to sweeping side skirts and 21” Titano alloy
wheels with red brake calipers. And to the rear, a low-set extractor
is again finished in Black Piano.
The GranSport trim option is also offered with the optional Exterior
Carbon Package. This features carbon finishing for the exterior
door mirrors, door handles and B-pillar cover plus the profile of
the front bumper.
24 25

T H E A T H L E T E W I T H I N
For even more sporting character inside the Maserati Quattroporte,
the GranSport trim offers front and rear Sport seats in leather firmly
sculpted for optimal support during even the most spirited drive.
The Sport steering wheel in leather and long gearshift panels in
aluminium offer precise control. And high-gloss Black Piano wood
trim on the dashboard along with stainless steel Sport pedals
complete an inspiring picture.
There is also the option of a carbon package. This adds lightweight,
tactile carbon finishing to the Sport steering wheel, gearshift
paddles, doorsills and interior trim.

higher levels of luxury. Which is why this model features a
remarkably exclusive interior, styled and crafted by Ermenegildo
Zegna, one of Italy’s most celebrated fashion designer brands.
